sourceTitle: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: everyday coding and agentic workflows for developers
originalTitle: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: everyday coding and agentic workflows for developers

blocks.text: Starting today, developers can build with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows. Built for rapid iteration, Hydrogen handles repository coding and debugging, interactive web development, and multimodal workflows — running standalone across four configurable thinking levels or alongside frontier models like Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon. With tighter instruction following and fewer fabricated claims, it helps you ship cleaner, production-ready code faster.
blocks.zh: 从今天开始,开发者可以用Gemini 4 氢来构建,将尖端智能带给每个人——以速度和效率为日常编码和代理工作流程.是用来进行快速迭代的,氢处理存储器编码和调试,互动网络开发,和多模式工作流程——单独运行在四个可配置的思维层次上,或与Gemini4碳和Gemini4Argon等前沿模型并列.紧随其后的指示 和更少的捏造索赔,它帮助你船清洁,生产准备代码更快。
blocks.en: Starting today, developers can build with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows. Built for rapid iteration, Hydrogen handles repository coding and debugging, interactive web development, and multimodal workflows — running standalone across four configurable thinking levels or alongside frontier models like Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon. With tighter instruction following and fewer fabricated claims, it helps you ship cleaner, production-ready code faster.

blocks.text: Start building with the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, Gemini for business, or, if you are a paid Google AI Pro or Ultra subscriber, try it in Google Antigravity.
blocks.zh: 在Google AI Studio和Android Studio中与GeminiAPI一起开始建设,Gemini为生意,或者说,如果你是Google AI Pro 或 Ultra 订阅者,尝试在谷歌反重力。
blocks.en: Start building with the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, Gemini for business, or, if you are a paid Google AI Pro or Ultra subscriber, try it in Google Antigravity.

blocks.text: Check out the Gemini API What’s New Guide for model details, setup instructions, and thinking-level controls.
blocks.zh: 看看GeminiAPI 什么是新指南的模型细节,设置指令,和思维层面的控制。
blocks.en: Check out the Gemini API What’s New Guide for model details, setup instructions, and thinking-level controls.

blocks.text: Read the Google Antigravity blog to see how new features like Orchestrator pair Hydrogen with Gemini 4 Carbon.
blocks.zh: 阅读Google Antigravity博客,看看Orchestrator等新功能如何将氢与Gemini4碳配对.
blocks.en: Read the Google Antigravity blog to see how new features like Orchestrator pair Hydrogen with Gemini 4 Carbon.
